36.linear: YaVM: native128 paired-row MD2; per-call BX/BV exponent scan, XP/WP signed-immediate Nat preparation; scalar fallback outside dimensions/domain
36.gemm: Ya3M: AP/BC/BP prep then scalar MD for each output; B-wide Yc bb scan plus per-column MQ scan; finite k>=20 pairlinear candidate replaces this extension and preserves original Ya3 fallback
36.norm: YbcN: Y8fL statistics plus LNr/LNj output mutation; native Ya7G output with rational fallback
36.candidate: pairlinear36 recipe targets shared B loads and two-row accumulation, incurs per-batch transpose/extract/flatten plus exact negative-zero bias. End-to-end benefit UNKNOWN; 16.82% predecessor reduction needed at saved snapshot
